prompt:
Make a transparent PNG VFX PARTICLE TEXTURE atlas, a precise 4 x 4 grid on a square canvas. This is NOT a sheet of complete explosions. EVERY cell contains exactly ONE isolated small fragment / particle, with ONE silhouette and no surrounding marks. Each will be emitted 10–20 times by a Unity ParticleSystem to form an explosion. Absolutely NO complete splash, blast, shockwave, burst, circle of fragments, cluster, bouquet, smoke explosion, multiple droplets or secondary flecks. One cell = one particle. Centered in each equal cell, large transparent gaps and minimum 20% cell padding. No grid lines, labels, text or background. Genuine transparent alpha.
Match the attached player only for drawing style: thick dark hand-drawn outline, cute simple flat colored doodle, 2D game art, restrained highlight, no realistic glow. No character or faces.
Cell order left to right, top to bottom:
Row 1: a SINGLE small pointed green leaf fragment; a SINGLE round-capped cyan water droplet with a white highlight and tail pointing RIGHT; a SINGLE short golden tapered electric spark shard pointing RIGHT (not a lightning bolt); a SINGLE short icy white-blue angular electric shard pointing RIGHT.
Row 2: a SINGLE rounded amber sticky honey droplet pointing RIGHT; a SINGLE tiny copper triangular metal chip; a SINGLE pale blue triangular frost chip; a SINGLE violet four-point magical sparkle.
Row 3: a SINGLE olive thorn splinter, tapered pointing RIGHT; a SINGLE silvery lilac four-point sparkle; a SINGLE tiny orange ember flame tongue pointing RIGHT; a SINGLE thin cream-yellow tapered spark streak pointing RIGHT, compact simple elongated diamond.
Row 4: a SINGLE tiny purple four-point cosmic sparkle; a SINGLE golden-orange ember tongue pointing RIGHT; a SINGLE translucent cyan irregular ice shard; a SINGLE rose-red ember flame tongue pointing RIGHT.
All cells are ONLY one particle apiece, no surrounding tiny shapes. The honey and water are little individual droplets, not splashes. Fire particles are tiny individual tongues, not explosions. This is a practical sprite sheet for procedurally emitted, separately moving particle fragments. Crisp high resolution outlines, flat color, transparent background.
